1.

2. The petitioner no.1 is the father-in-law, the petitioner no.2 is the mother-in-law and the petitioner

It is submitted that the husband of the de facto complainant is in custody and the petitioners have been falsely implicated.

sentences.text: The learned Counsel for the de facto complainant in opposing the prayer for anticipatory bail has referred to the statement of the neighbours and the victim.

Signed By :
GURUPADA CHAKRABARTY High Court of Calcutta 5 th of October 2024 12:16:46 PM 4.

Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the commission of the alleged offence and the statement of the victim from which it appears that she has implicated the husband of physical and mental torture and assault and having regard to the role ascribed to the present petitioners, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.
5.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners namely, Kartick Biswas @
Karticfk, Bharati Biswas and Jayanti Biswas @ Sathi, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/- each, with two registered sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.,
1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023 and on further condition that the petitioner no.1 shall meet the I.O. once in a fortnight and the petitioner nos.2 and 3 shall cooperate with the investigation till the submission of the final report.
6.

It is further directed that the petitioners shall appear before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Nadia at Krishnagar in connection with G.R. Case No.3394 of 2024 on or before 8th October, 2024.
